## Peer directory API for CLI and UIs

### Changes

- Adds `meshmsg peers` for a deterministic snapshot of the local node and currently discovered peers.
- Adds the versioned `peer_directory_v1` IPC capability and a `peers` request for UI clients.
- Local subscriptions now begin with an authoritative peer snapshot and emit sanitized `peer_discovered`, `peer_updated`, and `peer_expired` lifecycle events.
- Peer records expose only the canonical public key, optional normalized alias, online state, and bounded freshness/expiry metadata. Endpoint addresses and raw signed presence records are never included.
- Periodic presence refreshes update freshness without creating redundant lifecycle-event spam. Alias or routing changes produce updates; expiration is emitted once; rediscovery produces a new discovery event.
- The web bridge exposes a sanitized peers API and lifecycle events, refreshes its authoritative state after lag, and displays currently known peers.
- Legacy web event projectors now strictly validate canonical public keys and primitive fields to prevent nested endpoint or message-body data from reaching SSE.
- Adds peer-directory and adversarial web projection integration coverage to CI and release validation.

Aliases remain self-asserted convenience labels rather than trusted identities. For identity-sensitive communication, verify and use the canonical public key.

### Install

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/main/install.sh | bash
```

Restart running daemons after installation. Or install this exact source release:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg.git \
  --tag v0.1.14 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.13...v0.1.14
